description: Pulls the relevant changes from a pull request or a commit range, with the context a reviewer needs, into one verified review packet. Antigravity native hook wiring serves the review run gate.
name: recognitio
notes: Build 12 declared surface, not a primary shape. The primary plugins page documents plugin.json as the required marker with this $schema value and hooks.json as an optional component. This build names no skill, agent, rule, or MCP component, because the canonical skill is already discoverable at .agents/skills/ on the primary documented Antigravity skills discovery path.
